title: Submit the waitlist successfully
description: A prospective lead can submit the join waitlist form and receive a visible success confirmation.
category: Landing page browsing and section navigation

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the join waitlist form
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Fill in the optional message field with a short note
Submit the waitlist form
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Submit the waitlist successfully with complete details
description: A prospective user can complete the waitlist form end-to-end and see a success confirmation after submitting valid contact details.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the full name field with a valid name
Fill in the phone number field with a valid phone number
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Select a city
Select a user type
Optionally fill in the usage notes field with a brief description
Submit the form
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Browse the full landing page story
description: A visitor can scan the landing page from the hero through the footer and see the complete marketing narrative end to end.
category: Landing page browsing and section navigation

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll through the landing page
Verify the hero, value proposition, services, pillars, roadmap, trust, and footer sections are visible during browsing

title: Switch the site to Arabic with RTL layout
description: A visitor can change the site language to Arabic and see the visible content update with a right-to-left layout.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the language selector
Choose Arabic
Verify the visible page content is in Arabic
Verify a right-to-left layout is displayed

title: Switch the landing page from English to French and Arabic
description: A visitor can change locales on the landing page and see the visible content update accordingly, including Arabic right-to-left layout.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Switch the page language to French
Verify the visible content updates to French
Switch the page language to Arabic
Verify the visible content updates to Arabic
Verify the layout is right-to-left
Switch the page language back to English
Verify the visible content returns to English

title: Switch the site to French
description: A visitor can change the site language to French and see the visible landing page content update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the language selector
Choose French
Verify the visible page content is in French
Verify the landing page sections remain present in the new locale

title: Browse the landing page story from hero to footer
description: A visitor can scan the landing page from the hero through key value sections and reach the footer quick links.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll through the page content
Verify the hero content is visible
Verify the key product sections are visible
Verify the footer quick links are visible

title: Return the site to English after changing locale
description: A visitor can switch back to English after viewing another locale and restore the English landing page content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the language selector
Choose French
Open the language selector
Choose English
Verify the visible page content is in English
Verify the landing page narrative is restored in English

title: Read the English explainer and return to the home page
description: A visitor can open the English explainer page, read the long-form content, and return to the main landing page through the home link.

steps.description: Navigate to /about/nexa-pay
Verify the explainer content is visible
Click the home link
Verify the main landing page is visible

title: Read the Arabic explainer with right-to-left layout and return home
description: An Arabic-speaking visitor can open the localized explainer page, confirm the right-to-left layout, and return to the main landing page through the home link.

steps.description: Navigate to /ar/about/nexa-pay
Verify the Arabic explainer content is visible
Verify the layout is right-to-left
Click the home link
Verify the main landing page is visible

title: Toggle the theme to dark mode
description: A visitor can switch the public landing page from light mode to dark mode for comfortable browsing.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Toggle the theme setting
Verify the interface is displayed in dark mode

title: Toggle between light and dark themes on the landing page
description: A visitor can switch the public landing page theme and continue browsing with the selected appearance preserved on the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Toggle the theme to dark mode
Verify the page is displayed in dark mode
Toggle the theme back to light mode
Verify the page is displayed in light mode

title: Read the French explainer and return to the home page
description: A French-speaking visitor can open the localized explainer page, read the content, and return to the main landing page through the home link.

steps.description: Navigate to /fr/about/nexa-pay
Verify the French explainer content is visible
Click the home link
Verify the main landing page is visible

title: Toggle the theme back to light mode
description: A visitor can switch the public landing page back from dark mode to light mode.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Toggle the theme setting
Toggle the theme setting again
Verify the interface is displayed in light mode

title: Open the explainer page from the footer
description: A visitor can move from the landing page to the about article through the footer and reach the explanatory content page.
category: Landing page browsing and section navigation

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the footer
Click the link to view the About Nexa Pay page
Verify the explainer page is displayed
Verify long-form product explanation content is visible

title: Read the English explainer page from home link
description: A visitor can read the English about page and return to the landing page using the home link.
category: Landing page browsing and section navigation

steps.description: Navigate to /about/nexa-pay
Click the home link
Verify the landing page is displayed
Verify the hero section is visible

title: Use the alternate home route to reach the landing experience
description: A visitor can open the alternate home route and see the same landing experience as the main homepage.

steps.description: Navigate to /home
Verify the landing page hero content is visible
Verify the waitlist form is visible

title: Show validation when a required field is missing
description: A user leaving out a required waitlist field sees validation feedback and cannot submit incomplete details.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the full name field with a valid name
Fill in the phone number field with a valid phone number
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Leave one required field empty
Select a user type if needed
Submit the form
Verify a required field validation error is visible

title: Jump to a landing page section from footer quick links
description: A visitor can use footer quick links to jump to a referenced section and continue browsing from there.
category: Landing page browsing and section navigation

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the footer
Click a footer quick link to a landing page section
Verify the referenced section is visible
Verify browsing can continue from that section

title: Show a validation error for an invalid email address
description: A user entering an invalid email address sees a clear validation error and the form is not accepted.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the full name field with a valid name
Fill in the phone number field with a valid phone number
Fill in the email field with an invalid email address
Select a city
Select a user type
Submit the form
Verify a validation error is visible
